stories.headline: China Orders Meta to Unwind $2B Acquisition of AI Startup Manus

key_facts.fact: China's NDRC issued a decision to block Meta's $2 billion acquisition of Manus and ordered all parties to unwind the deal
key_facts.excerpt: China's National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) foreign investment review arm has issued a decision to block the sale of Manus. The agency said it has also issued an order to all parties involved to unwind the acquisition.

key_facts.fact: Manus relocated from Beijing to Singapore in 2025 but its co-founders Xiao Hong and Ji Yichao were reportedly restricted from leaving China during the review
key_facts.excerpt: Both were then purportedly asked not to leave China until the review was completed... Moving to Singapore allows many Chinese AI startups to circumvent U.S.-China geopolitical tensions

key_facts.fact: Meta announced the acquisition in late December 2025; Chinese officials began investigating it in January 2026 for potential national security issues and export control violations
key_facts.excerpt: In January, just days after Meta and Manus announced the deal, Chinese officials began investigating the acquisition for potential national security issues and export control violations.

key_facts.fact: Manus' move to Singapore had initially been cleared by the NDRC, but Meta and the startup did not inform Chinese authorities before inking the deal
key_facts.excerpt: Manus' move to Singapore had initially been cleared by the NDRC, however, Meta and the startup did not inform Chinese authorities before inking the deal in December.

key_facts.fact: Manus is an AI agent platform that autonomously carries out complex tasks; it was originally developed by Beijing Butterfly Effect Technology, founded in 2022
key_facts.excerpt: Early versions of Manus were developed by the Chinese startup Beijing Butterfly Effect Technology, founded in 2022.

stories.headline: Intellia Reports Positive Phase 3 CRISPR Results: 87% Attack Reduction, Files for FDA Approval

key_facts.fact: Lonvo-z reduced HAE attacks by 87% versus placebo in the Phase 3 HAELO trial, with a mean monthly attack rate of 0.26 vs 2.10 (p<0.0001)
key_facts.excerpt: A one-time infusion of lonvo-z reduced attacks by 87% versus placebo, with a mean monthly attack rate of 0.26 in the lonvo-z arm compared with 2.10 in the placebo arm (p<0.0001).

key_facts.fact: 62% of patients in the lonvo-z arm were entirely attack-free and therapy-free for the six-month evaluation period, versus 11% in placebo (p<0.0001)
key_facts.excerpt: A 62% rate of patients who were entirely attack free and therapy free in the lonvo-z arm for the six-month efficacy evaluation period, compared with 11% of patients in the placebo arm.

key_facts.fact: This is the first Phase 3 readout for any in vivo CRISPR gene editing therapy worldwide
key_facts.excerpt: As the first Phase 3 data reported for an in vivo gene editing therapy, today's HAELO results represent a profound milestone for Intellia, the broader CRISPR and precision medicine fields

key_facts.fact: Intellia initiated a rolling BLA submission to the FDA and anticipates U.S. launch in the first half of 2027 if approved
key_facts.excerpt: Intellia Therapeutics Initiates Rolling Submission of Biologics License Application to FDA for Lonvoguran Ziclumeran (lonvo-z) as a One-Time Treatment for Hereditary Angioedema

key_facts.fact: 80 patients were enrolled: 52 received lonvo-z and 28 placebo; all TEAEs were mild or moderate with no serious adverse events in the lonvo-z arm
key_facts.excerpt: A total of 80 patients were enrolled, with 52 receiving lonvo-z and 28 receiving placebo... All TEAEs reported as of the data cutoff were mild or moderate and there were no serious adverse events observed in the lonvo-z arm.

sources.title: Intellia Therapeutics Reports Positive Phase 3 Results in Hereditary Angioedema, Marking a Global First for In Vivo Gene Editing
Intellia Therapeutics Initiates Rolling Submission of BLA to FDA for Lonvoguran Ziclumeran

stories.headline: Iran's Araghchi Meets Putin in St. Petersburg as US Ceasefire Talks Hit Impasse

key_facts.fact: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi arrived in St. Petersburg on Monday to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin to discuss ceasefire diplomacy
key_facts.excerpt: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has arrived in Russia for talks with President Vladimir Putin, as Tehran intensifies diplomatic efforts to end the United States-Israel war on Iran.

key_facts.fact: The April 8 ceasefire mediated by Pakistan has been strained by disputes over shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and the US blockade on Iranian ports
key_facts.excerpt: The truce, mediated by Pakistan, has since been strained by disputes over shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and a US blockade on Iranian ports

key_facts.fact: Trump scrapped plans to send envoy Witkoff and Kushner to Islamabad for talks with Iran, citing 'tremendous infighting and confusion' within Tehran's leadership
key_facts.excerpt: US President Donald Trump scrapped plans to send Special Envoy Steve Witkoff and adviser Jared Kushner to Pakistan's capital Islamabad for talks with Iran on Saturday, citing 'tremendous infighting and confusion' within Tehran's leadership.

key_facts.fact: Iranian President Pezeshkian reiterated that Tehran will not enter negotiations while the US blockade remains in place
key_facts.excerpt: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has reiterated that Tehran will not enter negotiations while the blockade remains in place.

key_facts.fact: Araghchi visited Oman and twice visited Pakistan over the weekend before heading to Russia, building multi-channel diplomatic outreach
key_facts.excerpt: Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araghchi travelled once to Oman and twice to Pakistan over the weekend, before heading to Moscow to meet with Russian President Putin.

stories.headline: Iran War Disrupts PCB Supply Chain; Goldman Says Prices Surged Up to 40% in April

key_facts.fact: The Middle East conflict disrupted supplies of crucial raw materials for printed circuit boards, pushing up prices for tech firms globally
key_facts.excerpt: The conflict in the Middle East has disrupted supplies of crucial raw materials and pushed up prices of the printed circuit boards (PCB) used in almost all electronic devices

key_facts.fact: Goldman Sachs reports PCB prices surged as much as 40% month-over-month in April
key_facts.excerpt: Goldman Sachs says PCB prices surged as much as 40% MoM in April

key_facts.fact: Only five ships including one Iranian oil tanker passed through the Strait of Hormuz in a 24-hour period on Friday, according to shipping data
key_facts.excerpt: Only five ships, including one Iranian oil products tanker, have passed through the Strait of Hormuz in 24 hours on Friday, shipping data showed

key_facts.fact: Brent crude stayed above $107 amid the tensions; Citi raised its 2026 Brent forecast to $150 citing the Hormuz deadlock
key_facts.excerpt: Citigroup raised its 2026 Brent crude oil price forecast to $150. Citing the deadlock in U.S.-Iran negotiations and the ongoing Strait of Hormuz standoff

key_facts.fact: Oil prices jumped more than 2% on Monday as US-Iran peace talks stalled and Hormuz shipments remained limited
key_facts.excerpt: Oil prices jumped more than 2% after US-Iran peace talks stalled and Strait of Hormuz shipments remained limited, tightening global supply.

stories.headline: Taiwan Court Sentences Ex-Tokyo Electron Engineer to 10 Years for TSMC Trade Secret Theft

key_facts.fact: Taiwan's Intellectual Property and Commercial Court sentenced former Tokyo Electron engineer Chen Li-ming to 10 years in prison for stealing TSMC's proprietary data
key_facts.excerpt: A Taiwanese court has sentenced a former Tokyo Electron employee to 10 years in prison for stealing Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.'s (TSMC) proprietary data

key_facts.fact: Four others indicted received sentences of up to six years; one woman got a 10-month suspended sentence
key_facts.excerpt: Four others indicted in the case were given sentences of as much as six years in prison, with one woman getting a 10-month sentence, suspended for three years.

key_facts.fact: Tokyo Electron's Taiwan unit was fined NT$150 million ($4.8 million) and ordered to pay NT$100 million to TSMC
key_facts.excerpt: The court also fined Tokyo Electron's Taiwan unit 150 million New Taiwan dollars ($4.8 million) and ordered NT$100 million to be paid to TSMC.

key_facts.fact: Chen did not leak trade secrets beyond Tokyo Electron and its Taiwan unit; the judge said the company could have done more to monitor employees
key_facts.excerpt: Chen did not leak trade secrets to outside parties beyond Tokyo Electron and its Taiwan unit... But the Japanese company could have done more to monitor its employees, the judge said.

key_facts.fact: Tokyo Electron said it takes the court's finding 'with utmost seriousness' and has had discussions with TSMC to better protect trade secrets
key_facts.excerpt: Tokyo Electron said in a statement it takes the court's finding 'with utmost seriousness.' The company has had discussions with TSMC to come up with ways to better protect trade secrets and confidential information

sources.title: Former Tokyo Electron staff gets decade in jail for TSMC breach

stories.headline: Meta Signs Deal With Overview Energy for 1GW of Space-Based Solar Power for Data Centers

key_facts.fact: Meta signed a first-of-its-kind agreement with Overview Energy for up to 1GW of space solar energy capacity, with initial orbital demonstration in 2028 and commercial delivery expected in 2030
key_facts.excerpt: Overview Energy and Meta today announced a first-of-its-kind agreement and partnership to advance American-built space solar energy with initial orbital demonstration in 2028 and commercial power delivery expected in 2030.

key_facts.fact: Overview's satellites collect continuous sunlight in geosynchronous orbit and beam it to existing solar projects on the ground as low-intensity near-infrared light
key_facts.excerpt: Overview's satellites collect continuous sunlight in geosynchronous orbit and beam it to existing solar projects on the ground as low-intensity, near-infrared light.

key_facts.fact: The beam is invisible, less intense than sunlight, and passively safe for humans, animals, and aircraft according to the company
key_facts.excerpt: Overview's beam is invisible, less intense than sunlight, and passively safe for humans, animals, and aircraft.

key_facts.fact: Overview Energy's advisory board includes former NASA Administrator Jim Bridenstine and former FERC Chairman Joseph Kelliher
key_facts.excerpt: Overview's advisory board includes Jim Bridenstine, former NASA Administrator and Congressman; Mike Griffin, former NASA Administrator; and Joseph Kelliher, former FERC Chairman

key_facts.fact: Meta is one of the first major companies to secure rights for future space solar energy capacity delivered from orbit to the grid
key_facts.excerpt: With this capacity reservation agreement, Meta is one of the first major companies to secure rights for future space solar energy capacity delivered from orbit to the grid.

sources.title: Overview Energy and Meta Announce First-of-Its-Kind Agreement to Bring Space Solar Energy to Data Centers

stories.headline: Chinese GPU Maker Moore Threads Swings to Q1 Profit, Revenue Up 155% YoY

key_facts.fact: Moore Threads reported Q1 2026 revenue of RMB 738 million (~$107.9M), up 155% year-over-year, and net profit of RMB 29 million ($4.3M), swinging from a RMB 113 million loss in Q1 2025
key_facts.excerpt: Q1 2026 revenue reached RMB 738 million, a 155.35% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders turned positive at RMB 29 million.

key_facts.fact: Full-year 2025 revenue tripled to RMB 1.505 billion ($219 million), up 243% year-over-year, with a gross margin of 65.57%
key_facts.excerpt: Moore Threads released its 2025 annual report... reporting 2025 revenue of RMB 1.505 billion, up 243.37% year-over-year, and a 2025 gross margin of 65.57%

key_facts.fact: The company secured a RMB 660 million (~$96M) KUAE intelligent computing cluster order in March 2026
key_facts.excerpt: A RMB 660 million KUAE intelligent computing cluster order secured in March 2026

key_facts.fact: R&D spending was RMB 1.305 billion in 2025, equal to 86.68% of annual revenue, with 2,014 IP applications filed including 1,743 invention patents
key_facts.excerpt: R&D spending of RMB 1.305 billion in 2025, equal to 86.68% of 2025 revenue... filed 2,014 intellectual property applications by end-2025, including 1,743 invention patents

key_facts.fact: Shares surged on Monday following the results as the company is seen as a key player in Beijing's push to develop domestic AI compute alternatives to Nvidia
key_facts.excerpt: Beijing-based GPU maker turns a corner in the first quarter of 2026 after posting a US$16.5 million loss a year earlier.
